newsitem.title: CHINA: China service industry attracts more investment.
newsitem.headline: China service industry attracts more investment.

text.p: China's service industry attracted 56.5 percent of total investment in 1995, up from 49 percent in 1991, the overseas edition of the People's Daily said on Monday.

The proportion of investment in primary industry fell to 2.5 percent from 4.6 percent over the same period, while secondary industry accounted for 41 percent, down from 46.4 percent, the newspaper quoted a State Statistical Bureau survey as saying.
Despite the increasing attention paid by investors to opportunities in the service sector, returns remained relatively poor and were deteriorating, it said but did not elaborate.
It gave no figures for actual investment.

China has said its service sector accounted for 38.1 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) in the first quarter of this year, and that the period was the first for several years in which the sector's proportion of GDP increased.
